mapper.select: SELECT p.*,m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id=p.merchant_account_id WHERE p.order_id=#{orderId} AND p.status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE refund_number=#{number} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND requested_at<DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL 30 SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE channel_refund_no=#{channelRefundNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM refund_records WHERE refund_number=#{refundNumber} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.*,m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id=p.merchant_account_id WHERE p.id=#{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_records SET channel_refund_no=#{channelRefundNo},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND channel_refund_no IS NULL

UPDATE refund_records SET status='SUCCEEDED',channel_refund_no=#{channelRefundNo},failure_reason='',succeeded_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE refund_records SET status='FAILED',channel_refund_no=#{channelRefundNo},failure_reason=#{reason},failed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE payment_records SET refunded_amount=refunded_amount+#{amount},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{paymentId} AND status='SUCCESS' AND refunded_amount+#{amount}<=amount
mapper.select: SELECT id,event_type,from_status,to_status,detail,created_at FROM refund_events WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} ORDER BY created_at,id
